column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for the CD-file loader pair at the head of the combined OPEN resource unit.
# Both rows were checked with image-qualified disassembly/CFG, all direct callers and callees, strings, data references,
# adjacent boundaries, Ghidra candidates, source/history/match state, and FID/vendor controls. The pair is bounded by
# memory_release_last at 0x80015fb0 and the following TIM-upload family; the combined unit boundary remains WIP.

column8: a0 is retained as a pointer-output slot and receives the allocation; a1 is passed to strcat as the relative path; callers consume v0 as a signed success/failure result
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; memcpy, strcat, and the Psy-Q CD services are separately identified provider boundaries
